profile.roleTagline: Full-Stack Developer & UI/UX Designer | Graphic Designer & Brand Identity Specialist | Digital Marketer & Brand Strategist | Web Developer & Cybersecurity Learner | Esports Athlete & Team Leader
profile.bio: I’m a dedicated esports player, creative graphic designer, self-taught programmer, and digital marketing expert currently learning cybersecurity. I specialize in creating engaging digital experiences, developing modern websites and applications, designing standout visuals, and growing online brands through strategic marketing. As the leader of Team Unique, I combine creativity, technology, and leadership to build innovative projects and achieve ambitious goals.
